title: Rules
description: The list follows configuration order, with fixed precedence deny > force-ask > force-review > allow > review(default). The expanded row edits only scope, conditions and notes; every change goes into the draft first.
empty: No rules yet. Calls that need Arbiter start from review(default).
syntax: Exact, RE2 and glob all require the whole value to match; regex no longer needs to start with ^, so write the prefix or containment requirement into the expression itself. You can match commands, redirects, assignments, tool names or tool arguments read via JSONPath. The rule-level "Condition combining" setting decides how several conditions work together: with "all", conditions on the same kind of structure must be satisfied by one and the same node; with "any", one match is enough. Argument matching keeps JSON types, so numbers, booleans and null are not converted to strings.
name: Display name
scopeUnscoped: No scope limit: this rule applies to every tool and every agent, and only the match conditions below decide what it hits.
agentsPlaceholder: main, subagent, preset:<name>; empty means any
verdictDivision: Natural-language policy and review guidance judge authorization and limits; a deterministic rule only forces the resulting path and never makes that judgement; the review focus (hint) only points the reviewer at existing evidence and grants nothing.
conditionFieldWhole: Field: no field selected, so the whole {target} value is matched.
conditionFieldUnsetPath: Field: no JSONPath yet, so this condition matches no value.
combineDefaultNote: New rules and new conditions default to "all must match"; adding or removing a condition never overwrites the combining you already chose.
advancedConditionNote: This rule uses advanced matching (field selection, RE2/glob, multi-value or case folding): the semantics are the same as an exact match, only narrower or wider, so confirm what it hits in the test.
conditionsEmpty: No match conditions: you can keep editing, but it cannot be saved and applied.
valueTypeAfterInput: Available once an expression is entered
commentPlaceholder: Explain what this rule is for
hintHint: Provides review focus only; leaving it empty does not affect forced review.

behaviorOption.forceAsk: Human every time (skips the model and asks a person; refused when no channel can ask)
behaviorOption.forceReview: Always model-reviewed (always sent to the reviewer; a hint only adds focus)
behaviorOption.allow: No model review (the reviewer is not asked once the whole call is covered; an uncovered call still goes to the default review)

testDescription: Runs the rule layer and AST parsing only; it does not call the reviewer, write audit records or execute commands. It shares one implementation with /arbiter test.
inputHint: One per line; supports `bash: …`, `read: …` or JSON.
nameTitle: Leave it empty to use the generated summary; renaming does not change the rule ID, and editing conditions never overwrites a custom name.
combineCrossTarget: These conditions are checked across the whole call: the matching command and redirect may belong to different statements. The rule does not claim they describe one operation.
incompleteExactValue: Complete the exact-match condition value before saving, or switch the value type back to string or null
